method: Saved dev cases; weights exp(N/12). Exact gap contributions (normalized weight - 1/500)*(Q-1); geometry excess .5*(positive HPWL gap+positive area gap), remainder includes multiplicative soft interaction. Worst-five removal is diagnosis only, all published scores retain all cases.
limits: Historical task/panel/MIB/fixed-output semantics differ; width is confounded; common-bin standardization does not make an architecture control.
